minutes.headline: ZBA granted Maxi Auto a special permit to display up to 50 used cars at 40 Summer Street, 4-0.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard a single application from Maxi Auto Inc. for a special permit to sell up to 50 vehicles at 40 Summer Street. Members asked about space, paving, a berm at the setback, a parked trailer and hours. The permit was granted with the 2017 conditions carried over, and no one from the public spoke.

votes.motion: Approve the special permit for Maxi Auto for 50 vehicles at 40 Summer Street, with the conditions from the 2017 permit.
votes.outcome: passed (four members voting aye in the roll call; chair declared it granted)

decisions.decision: The special permit was granted with the 2017 conditions read into the record, including 20-foot setback from Summer Street, 50-car limit, off-street loading and set business hours.
The applicant accepted the hours of eight to six Monday-Friday, nine to five Saturday, and nine to noon Sunday or by appointment.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals voted 4-0 to grant Maxi Auto a special permit to display up to 50 used vehicles at 40 Summer Street.
The permit carries over the conditions of the 2017 permit, read into the record, including a setback from Summer Street, a vehicle cap, off-street loading and set hours.
The applicant accepted business hours of eight to six weekdays, nine to five Saturday, and nine to noon Sunday or by appointment.
Members asked about crowding, paving, a berm at the setback, a parked trailer and a tow truck; no one from the public spoke.

why_it_matters: A special permit sets the terms a business on Summer Street must operate under, so neighbors can hold the dealership to the vehicle cap, setback and hours now on the record.
